proposals.label: Speed over time
proposals.question: What is the average speed of each vessel per day?
proposals.sql: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 day', ts) AS day,vessel,avg(speed) AS avg_speed FROM telemetry GROUP BY day,vessel ORDER BY day,vessel

proposals.label: Top speed
proposals.question: What is the maximum speed recorded for each vessel?
proposals.sql: SELECT vessel,max(speed) AS max_speed FROM telemetry GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel

proposals.label: Speed trend
proposals.question: How has the average speed of the Atlas vessel changed over the last week?
proposals.sql: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 day', ts) AS day,avg(speed) AS avg_speed FROM telemetry WHERE vessel='Atlas' AND ts>=TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

proposals.label: Speed comparison
proposals.question: Which vessel had the highest overall average speed?
proposals.sql: SELECT vessel,avg(speed) AS avg_speed FROM telemetry GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY avg_speed DESC LIMIT 1

proposals.label: over time
proposals.question: How does the average water temperature change daily?
proposals.sql: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 day', ts) AS day, avg(water_temp) AS avg_temp FROM telemetry GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

proposals.label: max temperature
proposals.question: What is the maximum water temperature recorded and when?

proposals.label: temp vs speed

proposals.question: What is the average speed for each vessel per day?

proposals.question: Show the daily minimum and maximum wind speed for each vessel.

proposals.question: How does the average daily wave height compare between Atlas and Solstice?

rows.question: speed of Atlas every 10 minutes today

proposals.question: How does Atlas speed compare to Aurora over the same period?
proposals.sql: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '10 minutes', ts) AS t, avg(CASE WHEN vessel='Atlas' THEN speed END) AS atlas_speed, avg(CASE WHEN vessel='Aurora' THEN speed END) AS aurora_speed FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 00:00:00' AND vessel IN ('Atlas','Aurora') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

proposals.label: max speed

proposals.question: Show the distribution of Atlas speed today in 1‑knot bins.

proposals.label: wind vs speed

proposals.sql: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '10 minutes', ts) AS t, avg(speed) AS avg_speed, avg(wind) AS avg_wind FROM telemetry WHERE vessel='Atlas' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 00:00:00' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

rows.question: how many readings had waves above 4 metres, per vessel

proposals.question: What is the average speed of each vessel when wave height is above 4 metres?

proposals.label: Peak wave time
proposals.question: When did each vessel experience its highest wave height above 4 metres?
proposals.sql: SELECT vessel, max(wave_height) AS max_wave, ts FROM telemetry t1 WHERE wave_height > 4 AND ts = (SELECT ts FROM telemetry t2 WHERE t2.vessel=t1.vessel AND t2.wave_height>4 ORDER BY wave_height DESC LIMIT 1) ORDER BY vessel

proposals.label: Daily counts
proposals.question: How many readings per day had wave height above 4 metres for each vessel?

proposals.label: Location map

rows.question: in how many hours did Solstice see wind above 30 knots

proposals.label: percentage time
proposals.question: What percentage of Solstice's total recorded time had wind above 30 knots?

proposals.label: daily breakdown
proposals.question: How many hours per day did Solstice see wind above 30 knots?

proposals.label: compare vessels
proposals.question: Which vessels had the most hours with wind above 30 knots?
